comments.body: I would like to propose and discuss EIP 7801 with @Giulio2002 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9004

This came up on ACDC#145; to help with Fusaka testing it would be nice if CLs and ELs had the flexibility to unset some features, even if there is a hard fork encoded.

The motivating example: Want to run a `fusaka` devnet but only with PeerDAS, and e.g. not also deploy EOF.

What's the best way to address this?

Again very late request, but would like to discuss this change to the EIP-7002 contract.

-  https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9024
